article.story: ORONO, Maine -- — Panagiotis Pagonis’ 14 points helped Drexel defeat Maine 66-64 on Saturday. Pagonis added seven rebounds and three steals for the Dragons (2-2). Amaree Abram shot 5 for 11, including 3 for 7 from beyond the arc to add 13 points. Latief Lorenzano-White shot 5 for 9, including 1 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points. Hudson Franz led the Black Bears (1-4) in scoring, finishing with 16 points. Maine also got 15 points from Darius Lopes. Ace Flagg also had 12 points. Abram put up eight points in the first half for Drexel, who led 33-30 at halftime. Drexel used a 7-0 run in the second half to build a 10-point lead at 62-52 with 4:32 left in the half before finishing off the win. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
